blocks.content: Saved queries lets you save a query for later and pull those queries back into the editor. This guide helps you both save and reintroduce saved queries while editing a dashboard panel. These can also be used in other features, like Explore!

blocks.reftarget: div[data-testid='data-testid Panel editor content'] button[aria-label='Add query or expression']
blocks.content: Open a dashboard panel in **Edit**, use the **New query editor**, and select the query you want to save in **Queries & Expressions**. If saved queries are unavailable for your account, skip the remaining steps.
blocks.hint: Open a panel editor and select a query, rather than an expression or transformation.

blocks.content: To save the selected query, click **Save** in its header, then name the query and add a description and tags in **Saved queries**. Click **Save**, confirm it succeeds, and close the dialog.

steps.reftarget: div[data-testid='data-testid Panel editor content'] button[data-testid='data-testid save to query library button']

blocks.content: After a successful save, the query is available to reuse in another panel.
To replace the selected query, click **Replace** in its header. Find a saved query in **Saved queries**, then click **Select query** and check that the editor shows it.

steps.reftarget: div[data-testid='data-testid Panel editor content'] button[data-testid='data-testid replace query from library button']

blocks.content: Selecting a saved query replaces the query in the selected row.
To add another query, click **+** next to **Queries & Expressions**, then **Add saved query**. Find a query and click **Select query**. Check that a new query appears in the editor.

steps.reftarget: div[data-testid='data-testid Panel editor content'] button[aria-label='Add query or expression']

blocks.content: Adding a saved query keeps your existing query and creates another row.
